title: Buildings
description: Buildings of a region (CONTENT §5, §9). Behaviour is attached through optional capability blocks: recipe, house, trading_post (the island's capacity, pier and first building, D-051), warehouse (an inland collector, D-051), road, service, shipyard, work_area (a fertility requirement), workforce, fields (a farm that needs fields, D-049, D-051 part 4) and field (a field placeable: a 1x1 crop tile or a pasture module); requires_deposit ties a producer to a deposit tile; water_rows makes a water-edge building (D-051).

requires_deposit.description: Deposit kind one footprint tile must carry; the building may also stand on mountain tiles (MECHANICS §2, D-036 interim rule).

boat.description: The water-edge producer works with a boat (fisher): the life layer rows it out from the model's boat anchor and back (display only, CONTENT §11). Needs water_rows. Absent is false.

look.description: Who works the building, which sets its art (D-075 §3, ART_DIRECTION §3; no gameplay effect): rural (farms, fields, plots, primary producers, roads) wears the tier-1 look whatever its tier, workshop (processing) the tier-2 look, civic (houses, public buildings, market) and harbour (Trading Post, warehouse, shipyard, quay, pier, depot) the unlock-tier ladder.

smoke.description: The producer burns or cooks: its model carries chimney and smoke anchors and the life layer draws smoke (producers only, CONTENT §11). Absent is false.

water_rows.description: Water-edge footprint (D-062): each column independently starts with min..max sea-water tiles, then buildable land (quay counts as land). At rotation 0 the front is the top row. The loader checks min <= max < footprint depth.

placement.description: Shore placement (D-077 §5, MECHANICS §2): every footprint tile is water (shallows included) or level-0 land or quay, at least one tile is water, the back edge (the side opposite the front: the bottom row at rotation 0) touches land or quay along its full length, the harbour lane and berth tiles of the island's Trading Post and trading piers stay free; the footprint is land for ships. Excludes water_rows and coastal. Absent: the normal land / water_rows rules.

category.description: Build-menu category (D-077 §2–§3): ornaments (zero effect, no maintenance) or military (a dormant defence value). Absent: derived from the capability blocks (houses, production, public, harbour, roads).

defence.description: Defence value of a military building (D-077 §3). Nothing reads it until raids (D-005); the almanac shows it. Only with category military.

unique.description: Uniqueness scope (D-076 §2, D-077): island (one per island) or world (one per world, the Kontor). Plans count. Absent: no limit.

paint_family.description: Paint family (D-077 §2–§3): a 1x1 building painted tile by tile with the road tools' drag; neighbouring tiles of the family join (straight, corner, T, cross, end). ground: the tile is a ground kind instead of a model (square); road_crossing: a road may cross a tile of the family (city wall, rendered as an arch).

repairs.description: The building repairs ships (repair crane, D-077 §4). Dormant: ship health comes with raids. Absent is false.

harbour_lane.description: The building is a berth holder with a harbour lane in front of its water edge (D-078 §1): the footprint's width plus one tile on each side, four rows deep; quays, shore buildings and paint tiles are rejected on it. Needs shore placement or water rows. Absent is false.

gate.description: The building is a gate in the city wall (gatehouse, D-077 §3): placed with a road-crossing paint family on two opposite sides, a road may run along its centre line. Absent is false.

trading_post.description: The Trading Post (MECHANICS §5, D-051): one per island, placed only by founding; its level sets the island's capacity per good, a collector throughput and the berths of its pier.

levels.description: Levels in order. The first level is placed with the building cost and has no cost; every later level is reached by an upgrade and requires its cost.

warehouse.description: An inland collector (MECHANICS §5, D-051): adds throughput for the producers assigned to it, never capacity.

levels.description: Levels in order. The first level is placed with the building cost and has no cost; every later level is reached by an upgrade and requires its cost.

pier.description: A trading pier (D-060): a water-edge building that adds berths to its island (MECHANICS §9.3).

depot.description: A depot (D-062): adds capacity per good to its island; any number, no levels.

shallows.description: A quay (D-060): placed on shallow water (water within 3 tiles of the island's own land, not river) instead of land.

service.description: A public building serving houses within its radius (building needs). Either one radius or levels (D-056, upgrade_building): the first level is placed with the building cost; every later level needs a cost; level n of a building with levels needs tier n unlocked (positional, D-065: the loader derives it from the tier order).

chain.description: Service chain the building belongs to (D-065, e.g. faith). A chain building serves every need of the chain whose minimum rank is at most its rank, within its own radius; it has exactly one radius (no levels).

rank.description: Rank within the chain (D-065): unique per chain, contiguous from 1.

shipyard.description: Orders ships of the listed types, one at a time (MECHANICS §9.1).

workforce.description: Workers a producer needs from the residents of a tier on the same island (D-035).

fields.description: A farm that needs fields (D-049, D-051 part 4): its efficiency is min(1, active fields / required). Fields are placed from the farm's panel, next to the farm or one of its active fields (an adjacency chain), at most max.

type.description: The farm's one field type (field.type of the field building whose field.farm is this farm).

max.description: Most fields the farm may own (at least required).

field.description: A field placeable (D-049, D-051 part 4): a 1x1 crop tile or a pasture module (3x3 and larger, D-054) of one farm type, placed from that farm's panel on matching terrain (and fertility), 4-edge adjacent to the farm or to one of its active fields.

farm.description: Building type of the farm this field belongs to (its fields.type is this type), or a list of farm types sharing the field (D-056 C4: the cattle pasture of the dairy and cattle farms).

fertility.description: Island-wide fertility tag the field needs.

work_area.description: Fertility requirement: the island-wide fertility tag the building needs (MECHANICS §2, §4). There is no work radius or terrain rule.

fertility.description: Island-wide fertility tag the building needs (MECHANICS §2).

reach.description: Collector reach in tiles at this level (D-069, MECHANICS §5): a producer is assignable when its building footprint lies within this Euclidean distance of the collector's footprint (nearest tiles, the service-radius rule). Absent: no reach limit (pinned test content only; the loader requires it on every level or none).

upkeep_per_min.description: Upkeep in gold per minute at this level (D-069 hub upkeep); absent: the building's upkeep_per_min. Level 1 equals the building's upkeep_per_min.

berths.description: Ships that can load or unload at the pier at the same time (MECHANICS §9.3).

tier.description: Tier that must be unlocked to upgrade into this level (D-065, extended to the Trading Post).

cost.description: Upgrade cost into this level (gold from the world, materials from the island).

reach.description: Collector reach in tiles at this level (D-069, MECHANICS §5): a producer is assignable when its building footprint lies within this Euclidean distance of the collector's footprint (nearest tiles, the service-radius rule). Absent: no reach limit (pinned test content only; the loader requires it on every level or none).

upkeep_per_min.description: Upkeep in gold per minute at this level (D-069 hub upkeep); absent: the building's upkeep_per_min. Level 1 equals the building's upkeep_per_min.

tier.description: Tier that must be unlocked to upgrade into this level (D-065).

cost.description: Upgrade cost into this level (gold from the world, materials from the island).

upkeep_per_min.description: Upkeep in gold per minute at this level (D-069 hub upkeep); absent: the building's upkeep_per_min. Level 1 equals the building's upkeep_per_min.

cost.description: Upgrade cost into this level (gold from the world, materials from the island).
Construction cost: 'gold' plus materials by good ID (units).

recipe_input.description: One input slot: a good, or a list of accepted goods in preference order (D-056: ["charcoal", "coal"]).
